current_primary_internal_evaluation.estimand: arithmetic mean of 20 repeat-level Harrell C estimates with comparable pairs pooled only within each outer fold
current_primary_internal_evaluation.claim_boundary: conditional fixed-OOF evaluation; no refitting, retuning or full-pipeline uncertainty claim

secondary_ensemble_estimand.claim_boundary: ensemble of twenty held-out predictions per patient; not performance of one future fitted model

superseded_metric.reason: raw linear predictors from independently fitted outer-fold models were compared across non-comparable fold scales
